$comment: Pinned toolchain for authoring effect shaders. Fetched by
which is gitignored. `cargo build` NEVER needs any of this: the generated
HLSL is checked in (docs/SHADERS.md 2.3), so slangc is a CONTRIBUTOR tool,
not a BUILD tool. You only need it to author or edit a .slang source.
2026.12 is a deliberate pin, matching PEWPEW's toolkit.manifest.ts, so the
two projects share one set of codegen quirks. PEWPEW downgraded to it from
2026.14 after that release flipped the CLI's default matrix layout and
Only three files out of a 165 MB release are kept (~35 MB): slangc.exe and
the two DLLs it loads. slang-llvm, glslang, slangd/slangi and gfx are dead
knownIssues: The slangc CLI reads and writes REAL FILES only — there is no stdin/stdout mode for HLSL output. shaders.ts therefore stages the wrapped source in a temp directory instead of compiling in place.
It mangles non-ASCII paths (PEWPEW hit this with Cyrillic directory names and worked around it by wrapping the C API instead). shaders.ts stages into an ASCII temp directory, which sidesteps it.

#line directives in the output carry the ABSOLUTE path of the input, so a temp directory's random name would land in the checked-in artifact. shaders.ts rewrites it to a stable name — repo-relative for a built-in, the author's real .slang path for an app effect, so a runtime D3DCompile diagnostic points at the source.
PEWPEW also reports output-file races when several slangc processes run concurrently. shaders.ts compiles serially, which avoids it.

-reflection-json re-emits a string literal's SOURCE SPELLING rather than its value, so a C escape leaks into the JSON: [VnDoc("the element's edge")] produces \' and JSON.parse rejects the whole file. shaders.ts repairs the escapes before parsing (readReflection); glow.slang keeps an apostrophe in its [VnDoc] on purpose so the path stays exercised.

Reflection describes a ConstantBuffer<T> even when nothing references it and the HLSL backend has eliminated it. That is load-bearing, not incidental: it is how shaders.ts learns an effect struct's fields without them reaching the shader. If a future slangc stops reporting eliminated parameters, the probe pass has to reference the buffer and the real pass has to stop declaring it.
